items.exampleEn: Give me one more chance, please.
We can't play outside in these weather conditions.
items.exampleZh: 在這種天氣狀況下，我們不能在外面玩。

items.exampleEn: The bus fare will increase next month.
items.exampleZh: 公車票價下個月要漲了。

items.exampleEn: My boss puts too much pressure on me.
items.exampleZh: 我老闆給我太大的壓力。

items.exampleEn: Let's compare prices before we buy.

items.exampleZh: 練習會讓你的寫作進步。

items.exampleEn: Rain prevented us from going to the beach.
items.exampleZh: 下雨讓我們沒辦法去海邊。

items.exampleEn: The river is very powerful after heavy rain.
items.exampleZh: 大雨過後，河水的力量非常強大。

items.sentenceEn: There's a good chance of rain this afternoon.
items.sentenceZh: 今天下午很有可能會下雨。

items.audioEn: My English improved a lot after the summer class.
items.audioZh: 上完暑期班後，我的英文進步了很多。
items.questionZh: 說話的人的英文什麼時候進步很多？

items.sentenceEn: This old bike is still in good condition.
items.sentenceZh: 這台舊腳踏車狀況還很好。

items.sentenceEn: Don't compare yourself with other people.
items.sentenceZh: 不要拿自己跟別人比較。

items.stemEn: The number of tourists ____ every summer.
items.stemZh: 每年夏天觀光客的人數都會增加。

items.stemEn: My new computer is very ____. It can run big games.
items.stemZh: 我的新電腦功能很強，可以跑大型遊戲。

items.passageEn: Before the big exam, Tom felt a lot of pressure. His parents always compared him with his older sister. To improve his grades, he made a study plan: one hour every night. Slowly, his grades improved. On the day of the exam, he did not feel worried. He knew he had a good chance of doing well.
items.passageZh: 大考前，Tom 覺得壓力很大。他爸媽總是拿他跟姊姊比較。為了提升成績，他訂了讀書計畫：每天晚上讀一小時。慢慢地，他的成績提高了。考試那天，他一點也不擔心，因為他知道自己很有機會考好。

questions.questionZh: Tom 的爸媽總是拿他跟誰比較？
Tom 的讀書計畫是什麼？

items.promptZh: 這道圍籬能防止狗跑出去。
referenceEn: This fence prevents the dog from running out.
The fence prevents our dog from getting out.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 prevent＋人／物＋from＋V-ing（prevents the dog from running）

items.promptZh: 我上個月有機會見到那位作家。
referenceEn: Last month, I had a chance to meet that writer.
I had the chance to meet that writer last month.
rubricZh: 用 chance 表示「機會」，過去的事用過去式（例如 had a chance to meet、got the chance to meet 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關疑似 S6：prevents、compares 一定要接受詞，可靠文法刪去；換成不及物、語意不通的 waits、sleeps
執行長第②③關裁示修正：配合干擾項修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["增加","改善","等待","睡覺"]（原 ["增加","改善","防止","比較"]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：his grades increased 搭配略不自然，成績一般說 his grades improved / went up；且與本課 improve 剛好可對應，用 increase 易讓學習者誤學搭配。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Before the big exam, Tom felt a lot of pressure. His parents always compared him with his older sister. To improve his grades, he made a study plan: one hour every night. Slowly, his grades improved. On the day of the exam, he did not feel worried. He knew he had a good chance of doing well."（原 "Before the big exam, Tom felt a lot of pressure. His parents always compared him with his older sister. To improve his grades, he made a study plan: one hour every night. Slowly, his grades increased. On the day of the exam, he did not feel worried. He knew he had a good chance of doing well."）；increase 另有 mcq 正解
